basic_info.description: Perfect blend of classic charm and thoughtful modern upgrades in a prime NOPA location. Marina-style 2BR + Sunroom, 1.5 BA full floor condominium also includes 1 car tandem PK, storage, shared garden, and bonus/flex rooms behind the garage.Spacious living and dining areas are bathed in natural light through south-facing double-pane windows and flow into a beautifully remodeled kitchen with Bosch appliances, quartzite countertops, Heath tile backsplash, radiant heated floors,in-kitchen laundry. Bathroom features ceramic heated floors, a steam shower, Toto bidet, and glass doors for natural light.Storage abounds with a hidden bookcase entry to a wine cellar, custom built-in closets, and a large shared storage area in the garage.  One-car tandem parking is included.  The shared backyard is an entertainer's dream with turf, smart irrigation, cedar fencing, low-maintenance landscaping, and a premium DCS barbecue.    Included are Nest thermostat and smoke alarms, and a  4kW solar system for energy efficiency. W/smart-home amenities, abundant storage, and inviting indoor/outdoor living, this home balances convenience, comfort, and modern style in the heart of the city. Please note: s.ft (2049) is from condo map and includes both the main level (1506) and the separate bonus space (543)
